name_input: Export Promotion Council For Medical Devices
export_evidence: ImportKey page for slug 'export-promotion-council-for-medical-devices' (and variant '...-epcmd') renders only the generic template: 'Shipments available for EXPORT PROMOTION COUNCIL FOR MEDICAL DEVICES. India import data refreshed daily and available back to 2008' — no shipment rows, no dates, no destinations, no HS codes, no B/L numbers were displayed (0 rows seen out of 0 claimed). Volza and Eximpedia returned HTTP 403, so no second source could be read.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split found for this name. Search engines returned no relevant results (DuckDuckGo/searx unavailable: 'Connection refused'; Bing returned only unrelated Microsoft 'export' documentation pages). No domestic supply record located.
note: This is not a trading company but an export promotion council — a government/industry body (an EPC under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry ecosystem) whose statutory role is to promote members' exports, not to ship goods itself. It therefore has no own export shipments or domestic supply turnover to verify; absence of shipment records is expected and is not evidence of a shell entity. Declared HS 300420 ('medicaments containing other antibiotics') and industry 'Oil & gas and chemicals' are both inconsistent with a medical-devices council — HS should be corrected to the medical-device chapter (e.g. 9018/9019/9021) per Rule 3, verdict would be accepted_hs_corrected, but that is outside this shipments-only scope. No CIN/PAN/GSTIN found in public sources; revenue and export volume: null (not public). No traces of own supplies found — neither export nor domestic.
